headings: ### Also Look Outward (under Before You Try to Go Deep)

rows.label: Relationship paragraph · the danger line again
rows.article: If a relationship keeps making you feel less safe

guide.quote: Leave a relationship that keeps eroding safety.
And you do not need repeated exposure to danger before protecting yourself.
Distinguish what you noticed from what you concluded. … What did they actually do?

rows.note: At every push level (tight, default, wide) the new reader-questions step raised the same MUST: how do I tell it's been dangerous, right after being told the feeling may come from me? Now it goes by what they actually did, and old stuff stirred up too doesn't cancel it. 100% Human alone (68 words).
